purpose: Construct and audit MOS2+pn annular source, OOT, QPB, RMF, and ARF products before fitting any temperature, density, gas mass, dynamical response, Weyl response, or gravity law.
known_before_freeze: X1 calibration and X2a flare gates pass for MOS1, MOS2, and pn.
The immutable X2b1 mask contains 87 sources based on 783 calibrated PSF evaluations.
The strict sector-level FWC/corner gate retains MOS2 and pn and excludes MOS1 because MOS1 CCD5 has scale 0.3533430850668397.
The 650-900 kpc local hard-band transfer scales are 1.3134244395380283 for MOS2 and 0.7419486890802747 for pn.

No 10-500 kpc cluster radial count profile, annular spectrum, annular response, temperature, density, gas mass, lens residual, dynamical residual, or gravity residual was inspected to select these edges or adequacy rules.

correction_log.trigger: The first MOS2 X3 annulus produced zero selected events and a zero-area ARF before any usable radial count was available.
correction_log.cause: The immutable detection catalog includes source_id 50 at 1.075 arcsec from the predeclared cluster center with a 31.869 arcsec circle, so the generic point-source mask deletes the target cluster core itself.
correction_log.correction: Keep the 87-detection catalog immutable, but for X3 exclude only the 86 circles that do not contain the frozen target center. Retain source_id 50 in the science spectra and require an unresolved central-emission nuisance in the later likelihood.
correction_log.selection_rule: The correction is determined only by containment of the center frozen before XMM processing; exactly one catalog circle qualifies. No nonzero radial count, temperature, density, gas mass, lens residual, dynamical residual, or gravity residual was inspected.

correction_log.trigger: The corrected first pn source/OOT/RMF/ARF task completed, but the ESAS pnspectra wrapper wrote zero BACKSCAL for every quadrant and pnback aborted before creating an admissible QPB spectrum.
correction_log.cause: The official ESAS documentation records that complex selection expressions can make backscale fail at zero. The full 86-circle table expands the DSS detector-map bounds to the entire field even though most circles are disjoint from a given annulus.
correction_log.correction: For each immutable annulus, derive a compact FITS exclusion table containing exactly the unchanged catalog circles whose closed disks geometrically intersect that annulus. Circles disjoint from the annulus cannot change its event selection; removing them from the table changes only the SAS expression complexity and detector-map bounds. If the geometric subset is empty, disable source removal for that annulus because there is no intersecting exclusion to apply; retain the zero-row table as an auditable provenance product.
correction_log.selection_rule: Circle-annulus intersection is decided from the frozen center, annular edges, catalog positions, and calibrated radii only: separation-radius < outer and separation+radius > inner. No count value, spectrum, temperature, density, gas mass, lens residual, dynamical residual, or gravity residual enters.

correction_log.trigger: With compact masks, pn source/OOT/RMF/ARF construction completed, but pnspectra's default badpixelresolution=16 left every FOV/FWC quadrant BACKSCAL at zero and pnback aborted before producing an admissible QPB spectrum.
correction_log.cause: The official pnspectra documentation states that 16 is the default bad-pixel resolution and that a smaller number is more accurate. The official backscale/arfgen documentation gives 1.0 as the refinement example. The inner annulus intersects only pn quadrant 2, while selecting all four quadrants creates zero-support products for the other three.
correction_log.correction: Set pn badpixelresolution=1.0 and, for each immutable annulus, enable exactly the pn quadrant detector boxes that geometrically intersect its support. A quarantined a01 interface test then gave BACKSCAL=172000 for the source, OOT, FWC, and FWC-OOT q2 spectra and pnback ended normally with a positive QPB product.
correction_log.selection_rule: Quadrant admission is the closed annulus-versus-fixed detector-box intersection test. It uses only the frozen center, frozen annular edges, and pnspectra detector boxes; no event-count magnitude, spectrum, temperature, density, gas mass, lens residual, dynamical residual, or gravity residual enters.

fixed_geometry.edge_selection_rule: Six monotonically widening physical annuli were fixed before radial count inspection. No edge may move and no annulus may be merged, split, deleted, or replaced after extraction.

MOS2.ccds: T T T T F T T

pn.quadrant_selection_rule: Enable a quadrant exactly when its fixed detector box intersects the closed annular support around the frozen pn detector center; the mapping is frozen before the rerun and is independent of event-count magnitude.

extraction.source_catalog: The immutable 87-detection catalog and all calibrated radii remain unchanged.
extraction.source_mask: For each annulus and instrument use the compact subset of the derived target-aware 86-row mask containing exactly those unchanged exclusion circles that geometrically intersect the annulus. If that subset is empty, set withsrcrem=no because no catalog exclusion intersects the extraction support, while retaining the zero-row mask as provenance. The only non-excluded catalog component that could intersect the target is source_id 50, selected because its original circle contains the predeclared target center.
extraction.central_target_component: Retain source_id 50 in the source spectrum; a later XMM-specific likelihood must include an unresolved central-emission nuisance rather than assuming all retained central counts are diffuse gas.
extraction.response: Generate a region-specific RMF and ARF for every instrument-annulus pair; a full-field or another-annulus response is not substitutable.
extraction.invalid_product_rule: A failed or interrupted task directory is quarantined under an explicit invalid name and none of its products are admitted.

prefit_adequacy.scientific_role: Product and count-information gate only; it is not a fitted celestial-background, temperature, density, or gas-mass result.
prefit_adequacy.observed_counts: MOS2 source PHA counts; pn source PHA counts minus 0.0232 times the matching pn OOT PHA counts, all in PI channels 141-1400.
prefit_adequacy.QPB_counts: Counts in the matching ESAS mosback/pnback QPB spectrum in PI channels 141-1400.
prefit_adequacy.multiplier_rule: For each instrument use max(1, frozen 650-900 kpc hard-band transfer scale), so the prefit adequacy test never lowers an ESAS QPB prediction.
prefit_adequacy.combined_net_counts: Sum over MOS2 and pn of observed_counts minus conservative_QPB_multiplier times QPB_counts.
prefit_adequacy.combined_variance: Sum over MOS2 and pn of max(observed_counts,0) plus max(conservative_QPB_multiplier times QPB_counts,0).
prefit_adequacy.annulus_pass_rule: Every required product exists and is nonempty; all SAS tasks end normally without task error records; combined net counts are positive; and combined S/N is at least 5.
prefit_adequacy.stage_pass_rule: At least five of the six immutable annuli pass and the total combined net counts across passing annuli are at least 2000.
prefit_adequacy.forbidden_interpretation: Passing authorizes the separately frozen gas spectral likelihood only. It does not validate a temperature, density, hydrostatic mass, force law, dynamical response, or Weyl response.

next_gate_after_pass.protocol_required: A new XMM-specific joint spectral/spatial gas-likelihood protocol must be frozen before fitting; the existing Chandra-specific gas protocol cannot be reused unchanged.

failure_rules.fewer_than_five_annuli: Stop the RX J2129 XMM gas branch. Do not move, merge, or split annular edges and do not restore MOS1.
failure_rules.fewer_than_2000_net_counts: Stop the RX J2129 XMM gas branch without changing the energy band, QPB multiplier, or count definition.
failure_rules.task_or_product_failure: Diagnose only the engineering fault under a versioned protocol correction; do not change a scientific edge, mask, instrument, or threshold.
failure_rules.pass: Freeze an XMM-specific gas likelihood before any spectral fit, retaining fluorescence, soft-proton, and celestial backgrounds as nuisance components.
